notes: Hand-authored EN16931 UBL invoice, fictional data. Declared synthetic rather than sourced: nothing in the bundled corpus exercised the UBL syntax, so a CII-only reader silently returned nothing for half the standard. Shaped for TWO tax rates (21% and 10%) because a single-rate document cannot detect the multi-rate collapse, and it carries a schemeID=VA supplier id so the VAT-over-national-registration selection is exercised rather than assumed.
